TR-Saturn applies saturation specifically to drum transients to add weight without altering sustain, and Super Wide expands stereo width by up to 200% while maintaining mono compatibility.

Thenatan has released SKR8, a turntable performance plugin for macOS and Windows. The plugin uses a real-time, reversible playback engine to process user audio instead of using sample packs. Users can create scratching motion by drawing curves across eight tempo-synced tables or by using 22 built-in turntablist techniques.

The software includes five turntable models and several effects like stop, start, and backspin. Each copy of SKR8 comes with the RWND halftime and reverse plugin. It is compatible with VST, VST3, and AU formats and supports native Apple Silicon.

entry.title: Autodafe Releases Vintage Emulator Studio
entry.content:
KVR Audio | kvraudio.com | source

Vintage Emulator Studio (VES) is a free and open-source plugin that integrates MAME emulations of vintage synthesizers, drum machines, and samplers into a modern DAW environment. The JUCE-based tool provides the audio, MIDI, and graphical interfaces required to use hardware emulations from brands including Akai, Roland, and Yamaha as software instruments.

Available for macOS, Windows, and Linux in VST3 and AU formats, the plugin also functions as a standalone application. Because the software relies on the MAME 0.289 emulation engine, users must provide their own copyrighted ROMs and firmware to use the included instruments.
